title: Brinkerhoff, Hoppy and editing wire recordings for A&P
summary: Matassa recorded store interviews for an A&P coffee promotion on a wire recorder and learned to edit wire; that is how Hoppy came to work for him.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: And A&P, A&P did some local. There was a guy named Brinkerhoff. With a C. B-R-I-N-C-K. Brinkerhoff was, in fact, that's how it got Hoppy.
Hoppy originally worked with Brinkerhoff. That was your secretary?

Yeah. Yeah. He had a small agency, but really creative guy. Really, really sharp. And when I first met him, he had a local account with A&P. And we'd do store interviews. You know. And then trim the little parts of the extra pieces sticking out so that it would go through the gap on the head. Yeah. I learned to edit wire.
